finetuning_plan.objective: Full parameter or LoRA fine-tuning of pre-trained code transformer for vulnerability detection without data leakage.

architecture_and_model.input_handling: Sliding-window chunking (256-token windows, stride 128) with attention pooling over chunk embeddings to preserve entire function context beyond 512 tokens.
architecture_and_model.head: Binary classification head with linear projection and dropout 0.2.

training_hyperparameters.precision: fp32 on Apple Silicon MPS / fp16 on CUDA
training_hyperparameters.loss_function: Weighted Cross-Entropy (balanced weights for class parity)

validation_and_early_stopping_protocol.validation_split: Strictly GroupKFold out-of-fold folds on train_minus_dev (grouped by project) OR a dedicated held-out project slice from train_minus_dev.
prohibited_actions: NEVER use dev_heldout for training, early stopping, or hyperparameter selection.
validation_and_early_stopping_protocol.checkpointing_and_patience: Evaluate validation AUROC every 250 steps; early stopping patience of 3 evaluation checks.
validation_and_early_stopping_protocol.model_selection_metric: Validation AUROC and length-stratified AUROC on held-out projects.

hardware_and_resource_feasibility.feasibility_assessment: Full fine-tuning for 3 epochs is computationally feasible (~1.5 - 2.5 hours on Apple Silicon GPU), but requires explicit user approval before execution.

finetuning_plan.approval_gate: STOPPING AS DIRECTED. Awaiting user approval before launching any fine-tuning run.
